The fraction of cobalt present as the dithiocyanato complex Co(SCN)₂ is given by:

\[
f = \frac{\beta_2 [\text{SCN}^-]^2}{1 + \beta_1[\text{SCN}^-] + \beta_2[\text{SCN}^-]^2 + \beta_3[\text{SCN}^-]^3 + \beta_4[\text{SCN}^-]^4}
\]

With \([\text{SCN}^-] = 0.1\text{ M}\), \(\beta_1=9\), \(\beta_2=40\), \(\beta_3=63\), \(\beta_4=16\):

\[
\begin{aligned}
\beta_1[\text{SCN}^-] &= 9 \times 0.1 = 0.9 \\
\beta_2[\text{SCN}^-]^2 &= 40 \times (0.1)^2 = 0.4 \\
\beta_3[\text{SCN}^-]^3 &= 63 \times (0.1)^3 = 0.063 \\
\beta_4[\text{SCN}^-]^4 &= 16 \times (0.1)^4 = 0.0016
\end{aligned}
\]

Denominator = \(1 + 0.9 + 0.4 + 0.063 + 0.0016 = 2.3646\)

\[
f = \frac{0.4}{2.3646} \approx 0.1692 = 16.9\%
\]

Answer: D
